'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**The [[Security Cabinet of Israel]] approves the proposed [[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|Gaza ceasefire agreement]], which is expected to take effect on Sunday. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jan/17/israel-security-cabinet-approves-gaza-ceasefire-agreement (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]
**Twelve [[Communist Party of India (Maoist)|Naxalites]] are killed in a [[State Armed Police Forces|police]] raid in [[Bijapur district, Chhattisgarh|Bijapur]], [[Chhattisgarh]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/17/at-least-12-maoist-rebels-killed-by-indias-security-forces (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Nine people are killed during a [[shootout]] between [[Gulf Cartel]] gunmen and the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] (ELN) in [[Montelibano]], [[Córdoba Department]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/nine-dead-in-new-fighting-with-colombia-s-eln-rebels-official-2be8a3d0 (Barron's)]
*Three people are killed and seven others are injured in clashes with security forces in [[Juba]] and [[Aweil, South Sudan|Aweil]], [[South Sudan]], with three [[Sudan]]ese-owned houses set on fire in Aweil. This comes after videos emerged allegedly showing [[Sudanese Armed Forces|Sudanese soldiers]] killing South Sudanese civilians in [[Wad Madani]], Sudan. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9d55x6q7d3o (BBC News)]
 
'''Business and economy'''
*[[United Kingdom|British]] [[petroleum industry|oil and gas]] company [[BP]] announces that it will [[layoff|lay off]] 4,700 employees and 3,000 contractors globally to reduce costs. [https://apnews.com/article/bp-job-cuts-oil-b96729fc515a1495ca2fae320f62fefc (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A minivan rammed into a stationary bus near [[Narayangaon]], [[India]], killing nine. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/maharashtra-road-accident-on-pune-nashik-highway-dead-injured-2666217 (INDIA TODAY)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Zimbabwe]]an [[Ministry of Health and Child Care (Zimbabwe)|Ministry of Health]] reports that a new [[cholera]] outbreak that started in December 2024 has reached eight [[Districts of Zimbabwe|districts]] and infected nearly 300 people, causing one death. [https://www.dw.com/en/zimbabwe-cholera-outbreak-in-al-least-eight-districts/a-71333093 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 United States telecommunications hack]]
**The [[U.S. Treasury Department]] sanctions a cybersecurity company and hacker, both with ties to [[China]]'s [[Ministry of State Security (China)|Ministry of State Security]], for their alleged roles in hacking [[U.S.|American]] telecommunications companies. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/cybersecurity/us-treasury-dept-issues-sanctions-related-salt-typhoon-hack-2025-01-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iran–Russia relations]]
**[[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] and [[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] sign the [[Iranian–Russian Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership]]. The 20-year deal will see cooperation between the two countries in multiple areas, including [[Nuclear program of Iran|nuclear energy]], [[counterterrorism]], and environmental issues. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/iran-russia-inside-strategic-partnership-treaty (Middle East Eye)]

'''Law and crime'''
*''[[TikTok v. Garland]]''
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States|United States Supreme Court]] upholds [[Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act|a law]] that could ban [[TikTok]] in the [[United States]] on January 19 unless the social media platform is sold by its [[China|Chinese]] parent company [[ByteDance]]. [https://apnews.com/article/supreme-court-tiktok-china-security-speech-166f7c794ee587d3385190f893e52777 (AP)]
*A judge in [[Bolivia]] orders the arrest of former [[Bolivian President]] [[Evo Morales]] on [[statutory rape]] charges. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jan/17/evo-morales-arrest-sex-abuse (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Federal Police of Brazil|Brazilian police]] raid a ranch in [[Ponta Grossa]], [[South Region, Brazil]], in an operation to dismantle a gang planning large-scale [[Bank robbery|bank heist]]s, killing six suspects and seizing weapons, including a [[M2 Browning|.50-caliber machine gun]] and explosives. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-parana-bank-robbery-gangs-police-53d75f51e0bc35b3036f91a10a8ab97a (AP)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Colombian President]] [[Gustavo Petro]] suspends dialogue with the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] following accusations of [[war crimes]] against the group. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombias-president-suspends-peace-talks-with-eln-rebels-2025-01-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Second inauguration of Donald Trump]]
**[[President-elect of the United States|U.S. President-elect]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that his upcoming second inauguration will be held indoors at the [[United States Capitol]] [[United States Capitol rotunda|rotunda]] due to cold temperatures forecasts. Trump also announces that the [[inaugural parade]] will be held indoors at [[Capital One Arena]] in [[Washington D.C.]] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-inauguration-be-moved-indoors-due-cold-temperatures-cnn-reports-2025-01-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Didier Guillaume]], the [[Minister of State (Monaco)|head of government of Monaco]], dies suddenly at the age of 65. [[Isabelle Berro-Lefèvre]] is appointed acting Minister of State by [[Monarchy of Monaco|Prince]] [[Albert II, Prince of Monaco|Albert II]]. [https://www.monaco-tribune.com/en/2025/01/monacos-minister-of-state-didier-guillaume-dies-aged-65/ (Monaco Tribune)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Censorship of TikTok]]
**[[TikTok]] warns that it could "go dark" on Sunday without assistance from outgoing [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] and [[Presidency of Joe Biden|his administration]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2025/01/17/tiktok-pressures-biden-last-minute-00199145 (Politico)]
